416-428 DU ;; Decision-guide table restating ef-core technique and owner rules (tracking, projection, Include, bulk ops, compiled query, transactions, migration scripts, seeder, explicit recreation).

C arc007.ef-contracts OL ARC-007,ARC-016,ARC-017 MUST ;; Application defines persistence contracts (specific repositories, IUnitOfWork); Infrastructure implements them with EF Core; IUnitOfWork delegates to the same DbContext. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-entity-config EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep entity configuration separate with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. ;; = ;; none ;; Configuration-organisation technique not in the oracle.
C arc002.ef-config-out-of-domain OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Keep persistence-specific configuration out of Domain entities where practical. ;; = ;; Where practical. ;;
C arc023.ef-in-infrastructure OL ARC-023,ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Register EF Core and persistence implementations in Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep009.project-provider OL DEP-009,DEP-001 MUST ;; Use the database provider selected by the project; do not add a provider because it appears in an example. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.stage-commit OL ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; Repositories stage changes; the Application Service commits through IUnitOfWork. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc017.shared-dbcontext OL ARC-017 MUST ;; Repositories are injected independently and share the same scoped AppDbContext within a Unit of Work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.full-ef-in-concrete OL ARC-015,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Concrete repositories may use the full EF Core API; do not force complex queries through a generic CRUD abstraction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.projection OL RUN-006 PREFER ;; For read-only queries needing selected data prefer database-side projection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.no-overfetch OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Projection is not mandatory when the entity is needed, but avoid loading a full aggregate to return a few scalars. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-tracking EX RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Use tracking intentionally: tracking queries for entities modified in the current UoW; AsNoTracking for read-only entity queries; not mechanically on DTO projections. ;; = ;; none ;; Tracking technique outside the oracle (EXC-011).
C run006.no-lazy-loading OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Avoid lazy loading by default because it hides database access and causes N+1 queries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-query-shape EX RUN-006 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit query shape (projection for selected data, Include/ThenInclude when the graph is needed); for large collection includes consider split queries and verify generated SQL/performance. ;; = ;; none ;; Query-shaping technique outside the oracle (EXC-011).
C run006.db-pagination OL RUN-006 MUST ;; Apply filtering, ordering and pagination in the database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-deterministic-order EX RUN-006 MUST ;; Always use deterministic ordering for paged queries. ;; = ;; none ;; Deterministic paging order is a concrete correctness rule not stated in RUN-006.
C x.ef-bulk-ops EX RUN-021,ARC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not casually mix ExecuteUpdateAsync/ExecuteDeleteAsync with tracked entities for the same rows; understand their transaction and consistency implications. ;; = ;; none ;; Bulk-operation consistency caution not in the oracle.
C arc018.explicit-tx-need OL ARC-018 DEFAULT ;; A single SaveChangesAsync is normally the transaction boundary; use an explicit transaction only when a concrete use case needs several operations/commits to be atomic. ;; = ;; Concrete atomicity need. ;;
C x.ef-no-distributed-tx EX ARC-018,ARC-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not attempt distributed transactions with EF transaction APIs. ;; = ;; none ;; Prohibition not stated in the oracle.
C run008.compiled-queries OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Normal LINQ is default; compiled queries only on a measured hot path where profiling shows compilation overhead is material. ;; = ;; Measured hot path. ;;
C x.ef-interceptors EX API-011,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Use EF Core interceptors for infrastructure-level cross-cutting behaviour (e.g. auditing) and never hide business behaviour in persistence interceptors. ;; = ;; none ;; Interceptor placement/prohibition is EF technique outside the oracle (EXC-011).
C pst005.seeder-assumes-migrated OL PST-005,PST-004 MUST ;; The seeder assumes the Development schema is already migrated; developers apply migrations first and Development startup populates the empty schema. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst001.dataset-shape OL PST-001,PST-007 DEFAULT ;; Cover main meaningful states and relationships (created, active, completed, archived, optional values/relationships, status values, boundary states) without every combination; complex datasets should be described by task requirements rather than invented. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst006.anchor-detection OL PST-006 MUST ;; Use representative root/anchor entities to detect existing data (and skip seeding when present). ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst007.match-model OL PST-007 MUST ;; Concrete seed entities and states must match the current Domain and persistence model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst003.extension-delegates OL PST-003,PST-005 MUST ;; An Infrastructure extension creates the scope and delegates to the internal DbSeeder; migration strategy is separate from seeding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-migration-project EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Create migrations from the Infrastructure project, using the API project as startup project when required. ;; = ;; none ;; Migration-command technique not in the oracle.
C pst008.recreate-valid OL PST-008 MUST ;; After a model change recreating an empty Development database must produce seed data valid for the migrated schema. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-migration-scripts EX WF-019 PREFER ;; For controlled production deployment generated (idempotent) migration scripts are often preferable. ;; = ;; none ;; Deployment-artifact preference beyond WF-019.
C run012.query-optimization-order OL RUN-001,RUN-012 MUST ;; Start with clear LINQ and optimize after identifying a real problem; first inspect round trips, columns, N+1, indexes, SQL, plan, materialized data and tracking overhead. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.raw-sql-justified OL RUN-008,SEC-004 MUST ;; Use raw SQL only when EF cannot express the query effectively or measured performance justifies it; prefer parameterization-preserving APIs (FromSql, FromSqlInterpolated, SqlQuery); avoid raw SQL merely to appear performant. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.no-in-memory-filter OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Avoid loading all rows and filtering in memory when the database can filter, and lazy loading by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-no-fire-and-forget EX RUN-002 AVOID ;; Avoid fire-and-forget EF asynchronous operations. ;; = ;; none ;; Not stated in RUN-002 (which targets sync-over-async).
